items.title: Updated Guidance for Organisations Using the EASA Organisation Approval Tool
items.summary: Accessing guidance for the EASA Organisation Approval Tool is now easier for organisations. The training videos previously hosted on YouTube have been replaced by PDF user manuals for organisations, which are available directly on the EASA Organisation Approval Tool page on the EASA website. This update provides organisations worldwide with a central location to access the latest guidance, anytime and from anywhere.
